Its 16-row working stationarity did not certify the full 24,576-row problem: 1,804 full rows had negative slack. The 1,486,451,296 bytes of QR factors were memory-only, not exported or byte-audited; that absence is not repaired by retaining a manifest.

The separate same-run rawcell0band lane had its own failed direction result; it is not replaced by this QR warm outcome.
